title: version drift — root/node/rust 3 处版本不一致 (node 1.0.0 / root 3.18.0 / rust 3.5.0 / git tag v3.29.0)
description:
EPIC-145 canary 抓到 root `npm run build` prebuild hook `version-check.sh` FAIL. 独立复现: 3 处版本源不一致.

**已 confirmed drift**:
- `node/package.json` version: **1.0.0** (从没维护)
- `package.json` (root) version: **3.18.0** (老)
- `rust/Cargo.toml` version: **3.5.0** (更老)
- `rust/crates/*/Cargo.toml` versions: 待核对
- Git latest tag: **v3.29.0** (真实 release)

**根因**: v3.10.0+ 每 release 只打 tag + 发 gh release, 没 bump 各 package version 字段. 长期漂移.

**修法** (master 拍板):
- Option A: 都 bump 到 v3.29.0 (跟 git tag 对齐)
- Option B: 都 bump 到 v3.30.0 (canary 清账后 next release, 跟本轮 backlog v3.30.0 对齐)
- Option C: 加一个 `scripts/build-tools/bump-version.sh` 未来 auto-sync

**推荐 B + C** — bump 到 v3.30.0 (canary 完成的新版本) + 加自动化脚本预防未来漂移.

**关联**:
- EPIC-145 (npm build 诊断) 已发现此债, EPIC-145 已关
- 修完后 `bash scripts/build-tools/version-check.sh` exit 0
- 修完后 root `npm run build` exit 0
acceptance: 3 处版本源一致 (选定 canonical version)
如果加了 bump-version.sh, 未来 release 用它同步 (记入 docs/reference/)

verification.canonical_rationale: post-canary cleanup release; aligns with v3.29.0 borrow + v3.30.0 backlog convention (Master decision, ticket Option B).
verification.rust_crates_note: all rust/crates/*/Cargo.toml use `version.workspace = true` — no per-crate bump needed.
verification.cargo_lock: regenerated by `cd rust && cargo check --workspace` (OK success via exec-task.sh)

  package.json:        3.18.0
